top_headline: العنوان : القاهرة للدواجن (POUL.CA) قرار لجنة القيد بجلستها المنعقدة بتاريخ 28/10/2026اسم الشركة : القاهرة للدواجنكود الترقيم الدولي : EGS02 - معلومات مباشر
llm_summary:
- Cairo Poultry's nine-month profit has dropped significantly, with a 38.3% decline reported.
- The company's consolidated revenue increased during the first nine months of 2026, but standalone net income rose over the same period.
- Despite the revenue growth, Cairo Poultry's profit for the first nine months of 2026 was 1.439 billion Egyptian pounds, down from 2.333 billion Egyptian pounds in the previous year.
- The stock price of Cairo Poultry is expected to experience a downward movement, with a 35.19% drop allowed and a temporary halt set at 27.09%.
- Shareholders of Cairo Poultry are entitled to a cash distribution of 1.89 Egyptian pounds per share, with the end of the right to obtain this distribution falling on November 15, 2026.
- Cairo Poultry's third-quarter consolidated profit was reported at 152 million Egyptian pounds.
- The company's overall profit decline is attributed to a 39.1% drop in net profit, despite a 1.1% increase in revenue to 12.1 billion Egyptian pounds during the first nine months of 2026.
- This profit decline may impact the stock's performance and investor confidence, especially with the allowed price movement and temporary halt mechanisms in place.
